label: Site Name 3 (PWV) - Myofit sub-study.
meta_rows: Derived variables from the pulse wave velocity carried out in MyoFit 46 data collection. These variables need to be merged with those who have pulse wave velocity measured during the Insight46 Phase 3 sub-study.
cat_rows: Pulse wave velocity was carried out using a vicorder instrument. Participants who were unable to do the test during the Insight 46 Phase 3 sub-study were asked to do the test when they took part in the Myofit (2020-2024) sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
